COAStep.description: One step of a course of action.

NAME.description: The step, in the operator's words.

DURATION_SECONDS.description: How long the step takes, s.

ID.description: Identifier of the course of action, unique within its record set.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Catalog number of the object acted on; 0 when GROUP_ID names a group.

GROUP_ID.description: GROUP_ID of the $EGP acted on, when the course of action is for a group.

EVENT_STANDARD.description: Four-character standard code of the event answered, "$" included; never a union ordinal.

EVENT_ID.description: ID of the event's record; empty for an event that is computed again rather than stored.

EVENT_EPOCH.description: Time of the event, ISO 8601 UTC.

LEAD_SECONDS.description: MANEUVER: made this long before EVENT_EPOCH, s.

RETURN_WITHIN_SECONDS.description: MANEUVER: back in place within this long after the maneuver, s.

PREPARATION_SECONDS.description: Time out of service before a maneuver, s.

CHECKOUT_SECONDS.description: Time out of service after a maneuver, s.

DELTA_V_BUDGET_M_S_PER_YEAR.description: Delta-v the operator allows the object each year, m/s per year; 0 = not stated.

PLAN_ID.description: ID of the $MPL plan request that carries the maneuver, when one is stored.
